/** Sits above an import, which declares nothing. */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

/** Parses the input. */
export function parse(src: string): string {
  /** Inside a body, above a statement. */
  const trimmed = src.trim();
  return trimmed;
}

/** Separated by a blank line, and still the documentation. */

export class Parser {
  /** The source text. */
  source = "";

  // A line comment above a method sits on it and documents nothing.
  run(): void {}

  /** Above a directive, so not directly above the method. */
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-empty-function
  stop(): void {}
}

/** Above a re-export, which declares nothing. */
export { readFileSync };

/**
 * Options for a parse.
 *
 * @deprecated Use {@link ParseConfig} and see https://example.com/parse.
 */
export interface Options {
  /** Whether to keep `whitespace`. */
  keep: boolean;
}

/** A kind of input. */
export enum Kind {
  /** Plain text. */
  Text,
}

/** An identifier. */
export type Id = string;

namespace Util {
  /** Joins two parts. */
  export const join = (a: string, b: string) => a + b;
}

declare global {
  /** Extends the window. */
  interface Window {
    kapi: unknown;
  }
}

/**
 * Reads a file.
 *
 * @param {string} path - the file to read
 * @returns the file's text, decoded as UTF-8
 * @example
 * read("kapi.yaml");
 */
export function read(path: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path, "utf8");
}
